pundit.name: Clint Dempsey
pundit.take:
Man, "Bubba G" and "Ghost Pepper" goin' head-to-head in Arlington is like watchin' a firework show in slow motion.

Now, Bubba G's sittin' on top with 81 points, and his golden goose, France, is primed to take the stage. But let’s be real: Gunner probably thinks DR Congo’s gonna carry him through just 'cause his barber promised him a VIP haircut with Pogba. Meanwhile, Ghost Pepper’s takin' the field with Spain, but Devin’s the type to back the USA just 'cause they sell his favorite hot sauce in the team store. Spain’s lookin' to roast France on the field, and I’m callin’ it now – Devin’s spicy selections are gonna cook Gunner’s baguette dreams, leaving "Bubba G" scratchin' his head wonderin' why he didn't draft Italy for the pizza points. You can bet your boots it’s gonna be a scorcher, but I’m sayin’ Spain walks out winnin’ this Texas showdown, and that’s just the way the jalapeño crumbles.
